name: Kurosaki Tsukasa
source:
"Am I the same as those princes...? No way! I love you way way way more than them!"

The mysterious two-sided phantasm.

A mysterious youth who appears at the same time as the planet princes.
He's cheerful and sociable, but occasionally his true form shows...
